description: This file defines the class SugarFieldFullname, which extends the base class SugarFieldBase to handle the 'Fullname' field in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for rendering the detail view and sanitizing imported data by parsing full names into first and last names.

classes.name: SugarFieldFullname
classes.description: Handles the display and import sanitization of full name fields within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares the data for rendering the detail view of the full name field using Smarty templates.

methods.name: importSanitize
methods.description: Splits a full name string into first and last names according to locale-specific formatting during import.
